integrity: Explicit analytic proof and standalone numerical checks are provided; finite checks are not infinite proofs; no external independent audit has been performed.
limitations: Applies only to independently sampled uniformly distributed eccentric anomaly, not Euclidean arclength. No higher-dimensional or general convex-curve result is asserted. The known off-center-circle containment probability has the same dilogarithm curve, so historical priority of the geometric identity remains provisional.
title: Sharp dilogarithmic acuteness law for affine-uniform ellipse triangles
